source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.1.2 (PDF 208-209), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Business solutions woh tareeqe hain jo companies ko masail hal karne aur behtar kaam karne mein madad dete hain.

Misal: farz karein aap ki chhoti si grocery ki dukaan hai. Agar aap dekhte hain ke cheezein aksar khatam (out of stock) ho jati hain, to business solution yeh ho sakta hai ke zyada jaldi jaldi order dein, ya inventory (dukaan mein maujood maal) ka hisab rakhne ke liye software istemal karein. Is se shelves bhari rehti hain aur customers khush rehte hain.

Business solutions sirf masle theek karne ka naam nahi; yeh karobar ko barhne aur behtar hone mein bhi madad dete hain. Maslan agar zyada customers online shopping karne lagein to aap home delivery shuru kar sakte hain. Is tarah aap ka karobar badalte halaat ke saath chalta rehta hai aur taraqqi karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Bakery ke counter par lambi qataaren lagti hain. Is ka ek business solution bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Maslan customers online ya phone par pehle se order kar dein aur aa kar utha lein (pick-up), ya rush ke waqt doosra payment counter khol diya jaye. Yeh sirf samjhane ke liye misal hai.

items: Business solution: masla hal karna (inventory software) aur karobar barhana (home delivery).
